title: RTI-style FAQ
promptText:
Using only the public circular / policy text provided, generate an RTI-style FAQ for citizens and junior staff.

Create 8–10 Q&A pairs covering:
- What the scheme / order is
- Who is eligible or affected
- How to apply / comply
- Timelines mentioned in the source
- Documents required (only if stated)
- Grievance / appeal path (only if stated)
- What is explicitly not covered

Rules:
- Answers must be grounded in the pasted text. Quote or paraphrase closely.
- If the source is silent, answer: "Not specified in the provided circular." Do not invent.
- Keep each answer under 60 words.
- Add a final section: "Points requiring official confirmation" listing any ambiguities.
- Formal, neutral tone suitable for a public FAQ page.

PUBLIC CIRCULAR TEXT:
[Paste text — public / gazetted content only]
